title: Husband Beater: Defies Cops After Slashing All Clothes With Butcher Knife!
description:
On January 25th, 2023, officers in Florida responded to a hotel after a man reported his wife had cut up his clothes with a butcher knife. The man had also reported his wife had punched him prior to officers arriving. Upon arrival at the hotel, the officers went to locate the female suspect, who was found sitting in the passenger seat of a vehicle in the parking lot.

Despite repeated commands, the suspect initially refused to exit the vehicle and appeared to be intoxicated. The suspect continued to yell and refused to listen to officers. The situation escalated when additional officers arrived and threatened to break the vehicle's window if she did not comply. Eventually, she agreed to open the door but resisted exiting the vehicle. 

The suspect was placed under arrest and placed in handcuffs before being transported to the police station. During the arrest, the suspect was uncooperative with officers, yelling at officers and refusing to listen to her Miranda rights. The suspect was charged with Battery and Resisting an Officer Without Violence.
